name: create-klein
description: Create a small, fast Preact SSR site on Bun or Cloudflare Workers, with SQLite, Postgres or D1.
author: Michał Majchrzak

scripts.prepack: bun run build && rm -rf template && cp -R ../template template && cp ../LICENSE LICENSE && find template -name node_modules -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && mv template/base/.gitignore template/base/gitignore
